body:
> It is the value of the facet?

In your example, the value of `imageDescription` each record.
However that would involve passing each record through this function, which I'm sure is not what would be happening.

...So maybe a function doesn't make sense.

Initially I was thinking an array, because it felt similar to how you would pass a [FacetList](https://community.algolia.com/algoliasearch-helper-js/reference.html#SearchParameters.FacetList) to `SearchParameters.disjunctiveFacetsRefinements`.
